description: React component for displaying a finalized persona page in a Next.js application, including data fetching, state management, and rendering persona details such as name, role, summary, competencies, and career highlights.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is a non-empty object.

methods.name: asStringArray

methods.name: coerceCareerHighlights

methods.name: extractFinalPersonaFromOrchestrationRecord
